definition.title: Prepare a Show HN launch
definition.description: Judges whether the product is ready to show on Hacker News, then drafts the Show HN title, post, first comment and answers to the hardest questions in your voice, recommends a concrete posting window, and checks the packet against HN's own rules. Remembers past attempts so it never suggests a repost too soon. Never posts, submits, upvotes or contacts anyone.

what_to_show.title: What you want to show (optional)
what_to_show.description: The one thing a stranger could open and try, and why a technical audience should care. Leave empty to show what the Feature map and growth plan point to.

target_url.title: Link to show (optional)
target_url.description: The exact https link people will open: the live product, a demo, or the repository. Leave empty to take it from project context.

founder_available.title: Day you can sit with the thread (optional)
founder_available.description: The earliest weekday (YYYY-MM-DD) you can be free to reply to every comment for the whole launch day. Leave empty to time it from today.

past_launches.title: Show HN posts done outside Tin (optional)
past_launches.description: URLs you already launched on Hacker News, so a repost is not suggested too soon. Targets prepared in earlier runs are remembered automatically.

tone_notes.title: Voice notes (optional)
tone_notes.description: How the title, post and first comment should sound. The project's writing style guide is used when present; these notes win where they differ.

prerequisites.reason: The Feature map supplies the technical story and every product claim the launch makes.
The growth plan says who the business serves and records hard no's such as no founder posting.
A captured writing style guide shapes the drafted title, post and comment; tone_notes still win.
